overview_description.description: Autostep develops enterprise software that analyzes everyday desktop activity to uncover repetitive, high-cost tasks inside organizations. Its desktop application runs across teams, monitoring how work is performed and converting observed actions into structured operational data. The platform ranks tasks by financial impact and ease of remediation, helping companies decide which processes are worth automating or redesigning. Autostep then suggests or helps deploy solutions such as AI agents, workflow automations, process changes, or external tools aligned with actual work patterns. It maintains a queryable record of tasks and workflows so operations teams can review how work happens and measure the results of changes over time. Autostep targets businesses seeking to reduce manual work, improve process efficiency, and guide automation investments using real operational evidence.
